component.name: Colorz
component.summary: Pick colors from the screen and keep palettes

description.p: Colorz is a color picker that lives in the GNOME top bar. Pick any pixel on screen with a global shortcut, copy it in the format you need, fine-tune it on a color wheel, and collect it into named palettes.

ul.li: Pick from any app through the desktop portal, from a shortcut (Super+Shift+C), the tray menu or the Pick button
Copy as HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, OKLCH, OKLab or CSS color(), with or without the function wrapper
Convert on copy to Display P3, Adobe RGB or a custom ICC profile, with a warning for out-of-gamut colors
Paste any CSS color to load it, and keep a history of recent picks
Ring, OKLCH and OKHSL wheels with per-channel sliders and keyboard nudging
Complementary, analogous, triad and split-complementary harmonies, each color ready to copy
Named palettes with labels and CSS variable names, added to in one click from the Pick and Wheel tabs
Edit a palette color on the wheel or replace it with a new pick, with undo
Import and export CSS variables and GIMP palettes, or extract a palette from an image
